svg.title: Radio Case Fan Controller - schematic / wiring diagram
svg.text: Radio Case Fan Controller — Schematic / Wiring Diagram
ESP32 + DS18B20 + 1–2 × Noctua NF-A4x20 5V PWM · target enclosure: ICOM IC-2730A case · rev A
PROTECTION STAGE — TODO, not on the breadboard yet
GND — star point at U1 OUT−
Trim U1 to 5.00 V on the bench, unloaded, before
D1 / D2 / C1 are planned, not yet built. Until they
exist, a polarity mistake at J1 kills U1 and the ESP32.
Tach (pin 3) is open-collector: pull up to +3.3 V only.
A pull-up to +5 V puts 5 V on a GPIO — do not do it.
PWM (pin 4) is a 3.3 V push-pull LEDC output at 25 kHz.
Noctua 5 V PWM fans accept a 3.3 V control signal.
R2 / R3 are external pull-ups; the ESPHome config also
enables INPUT_PULLUP. The internal one (~45 k) alone is
weak for the tach edge — keep the 10 k parts.
Star-ground at U1 OUT−. Do not daisy-chain fan return
current through the ESP32 GND pin.
Current budget: ESP32 ~250 mA avg / ~500 mA Wi-Fi peak,
plus ~2 × 120 mA of fan — well inside U1’s 2 A.
Fan 2 is optional. In single-fan mode its PWM is held at
0 %; leave it unpopulated for passive intake.
R1 sits at the probe end of the 1 m lead, across the red
See docs/wiring.md for the net-by-net connection table.
